entities.name: Peptidoglycan transglycosylase A8AQ99
observations: The query sequence is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt A8AQ99, annotated as a peptidoglycan polymerase that elongates glycan chains from lipid-linked precursors.
Reviewed homolog annotations place this protein at the bacterial inner membrane and associate it with peptidoglycan biosynthesis and cell-wall biogenesis.
The query contains Pfam Transgly domain PF00912 at residues 61–227.
